summary: Vystar Corp filed an 8-K reporting entry into a joint venture with Capital Realm, Inc. on August 4, 2026, to acquire a 50% interest each in r3alm, Inc., a compliance-focused AI/Web3 financial ecosystem. The deal terms include issuance of 8,371 Series B preferred shares convertible into 8,371,000 common shares fully vested upon proof of intellectual property concept. The platform spans 22 modules including capital formation, tokenized assets, and AI intelligence. The transaction involves unregistered securities and includes a planned R3EQ equity-linked token. No termination fee, premium, or expected close date stated; watch for IP concept verification and conversion vesting.
